# Components

<!-- Generated by "npm run gen:catalog -- --write". Do not edit by hand. -->

Each section has the props, an A2UI payload and the matching web component `config`.

- In A2UI, a `string`, `number` or `boolean` prop can be a data binding like `{ "path": "/title" }`. A `config` takes plain values.
- Every component also takes an optional `action`. It tells the agent about errors and events ([host-api.md](host-api.md)).
- A2UI components have no `ks` prop. The host supplies the KS with `setKsProvider` ([host-integration.md](host-integration.md#kaltura-session-ks)).

| Component | Element | Needs a KS |
|---|---|---|
| [KalturaPlayer](#kalturaplayer) | `<kaltura-player>` | Only for protected entries |
| [KalturaFlashcards](#kalturaflashcards) | `<kaltura-flashcards>` | Only for protected entries |
| [KalturaMediaManager](#kalturamediamanager) | `<kaltura-media-manager>` | Yes |
| [KalturaAnalytics](#kalturaanalytics) | `<kaltura-analytics>` | Yes |
| [KalturaCaptionsEditor](#kalturacaptionseditor) | `<kaltura-captions-editor>` | Yes |
| [KalturaRecorder](#kalturarecorder) | `<kaltura-recorder>` | Yes |
| [KalturaAvatar](#kalturaavatar) | `<kaltura-avatar>` | Yes |
| [KalturaGenie](#kalturagenie) | `<kaltura-genie-widget>` | Yes |
| [KalturaContentLab](#kalturacontentlab) | `<kaltura-content-lab>` | Yes |
| [KalturaAgentsWidget](#kalturaagentswidget) | `<kaltura-agents-widget>` | Yes |
| [KalturaVodAvatar](#kalturavodavatar) | `<kaltura-vod-avatar-wc>` | Yes |
| [KalturaChart](#kalturachart) | `<kaltura-chart>` | No |

## KalturaPlayer

Plays one entry with the player (uiConf) the host allows.

Element: `<kaltura-player>`. Needs a KS: Only for protected entries.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `partnerId` | integer | yes |  | Kaltura partner (account) ID. Integer, not a string, not a binding. |
| `uiconfId` | integer | yes |  | Player (uiConf) ID. Integer, not a string, not a binding. |
| `entryId` | string | yes |  | Entry ID to play, a string like '0_abc123'. |
| `autoplay` | boolean |  | `false` | Auto-start playback. Requires muted=true per browser policy. Default: false. |
| `muted` | boolean |  | `false` | Start muted. Must be true when autoplay is true. Default: false. |
| `startTime` | number |  |  | Seek to this position (seconds) on load. |
| `clipTo` | number |  |  | Stop playback at this position (seconds). |
| `aspectRatio` | string |  | `"16/9"` | Container aspect ratio (e.g. '16/9', '4/3'). Default: '16/9'. |
| `entryName` | string |  |  | Optional entry name shown in the player title. |
| `entryDescription` | string |  |  | Optional entry description shown under the player. HTML tags are stripped. |
| `region` | string |  |  | Optional. The Kaltura region of this widget's account: nvp1 (US), irp2 (EU), frp2 (DE), cap2 (CA), syp2 (AP), sgp2 (SG), or a name the host app defined. Leave it out to use the app's region. A region the host app does not allow is refused. |

A2UI messages, sent after `createSurface`:

```json
[
  {
    "version": "v0.9",
    "updateDataModel": {
      "surfaceId": "s",
      "path": "/",
      "value": {
        "entryId": "0_abc"
      }
    }
  },
  {
    "version": "v0.9",
    "updateComponents": {
      "surfaceId": "s",
      "components": [
        {
          "id": "root",
          "component": "KalturaPlayer",
          "partnerId": 1,
          "uiconfId": 2,
          "entryId": {
            "path": "/entryId"
          },
          "autoplay": true,
          "muted": true
        }
      ]
    }
  }
]
```

The same in a web component:

```html
<kaltura-player></kaltura-player>
<script>
  document.querySelector('kaltura-player').config = {
    "partnerId": 1,
    "uiconfId": 2,
    "entryId": "0_abc",
    "autoplay": true,
    "muted": true
  };
</script>
```

## KalturaFlashcards

A deck of study cards. Each card can have video clips. The cards are literal: to change them, send the component again.

Element: `<kaltura-flashcards>`. Needs a KS: Only for protected entries.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `partnerId` | integer |  |  | Kaltura partner (account) ID. Needed to play the clips. Integer, not a string, not a binding. |
| `uiconfId` | integer |  |  | Player (uiConf) ID used to play the clips. Integer, not a string, not a binding. |
| `title` | string | yes |  | Title of the flashcard deck. |
| `summary` | string |  |  | Brief summary or description of the flashcard deck. |
| `cards` | object[] | yes |  | Ordered list of cards. Literal only, no data binding: to change the cards, send the component again. |
| `region` | string |  |  | Optional. The Kaltura region of this widget's account: nvp1 (US), irp2 (EU), frp2 (DE), cap2 (CA), syp2 (AP), sgp2 (SG), or a name the host app defined. Leave it out to use the app's region. A region the host app does not allow is refused. |

A2UI messages, sent after `createSurface`:

```json
[
  {
    "version": "v0.9",
    "updateDataModel": {
      "surfaceId": "s",
      "path": "/",
      "value": {
        "deck": {
          "title": "Biology"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  {
    "version": "v0.9",
    "updateComponents": {
      "surfaceId": "s",
      "components": [
        {
          "id": "root",
          "component": "KalturaFlashcards",
          "title": {
            "path": "/deck/title"
          },
          "cards": [
            {
              "title": "Cell",
              "content": "The basic unit of life."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
]
```

The same in a web component:

```html
<kaltura-flashcards></kaltura-flashcards>
<script>
  document.querySelector('kaltura-flashcards').config = {
    "title": "Biology",
    "cards": [
      {
        "title": "Cell",
        "content": "The basic unit of life."
      }
    ]
  };
</script>
```

## KalturaMediaManager

Library browser for the account's media. In 'select' mode the user picks entries and the action gets their IDs. 'manage' mode also lets the user edit them.

Element: `<kaltura-media-manager>`. Needs a KS: Yes.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `partnerId` | integer | yes |  | Kaltura partner (account) ID. Integer, not a string, not a binding. |
| `serverUrl` | string |  |  | Optional. Leave it out to use the Unisphere host of the app's region. Otherwise a Kaltura Unisphere URL (e.g. 'https://unisphere.nvp1.ovp.kaltura.com/v1'). Only Kaltura hosts are accepted (regions nvp1, irp2, frp2, cap2, syp2, sgp2). Other hosts are refused. |
| `theme` | "dark" / "light" |  |  | UI theme mode. Default: the host page's data-theme attribute, else 'dark'. |
| `mode` | "select" / "manage" |  | `"select"` | Interaction mode. 'select' shows the select button. 'manage' hides it. What the user can change comes from the KS role. Default: 'select'. |
| `multiSelect` | boolean |  | `false` | Allow picking up to 5 entries. Default: false. |
| `contextId` | string |  |  | ID of the content scope (e.g. category ID to browse). |
| `region` | string |  |  | Optional. The Kaltura region of this widget's account: nvp1 (US), irp2 (EU), frp2 (DE), cap2 (CA), syp2 (AP), sgp2 (SG), or a name the host app defined. Leave it out to use the app's region. A region the host app does not allow is refused. |

A2UI messages, sent after `createSurface`:

```json
[
  {
    "version": "v0.9",
    "updateComponents": {
      "surfaceId": "s",
      "components": [
        {
          "id": "root",
          "component": "KalturaMediaManager",
          "partnerId": 1,
          "serverUrl": "https://unisphere.nvp1.ovp.kaltura.com/v1",
          "mode": "select"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
]
```

The same in a web component:

```html
<kaltura-media-manager></kaltura-media-manager>
<script>
  document.querySelector('kaltura-media-manager').config = {
    "partnerId": 1,
    "serverUrl": "https://unisphere.nvp1.ovp.kaltura.com/v1",
    "mode": "select"
  };
</script>
```

## KalturaAnalytics

Kaltura Analytics: shows one view of the analytics app, for a media entry or a report type, over a date range. The host supplies the Kaltura Session, so there is no ks prop.

Element: `<kaltura-analytics>`. Needs a KS: Yes.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `partnerId` | integer | yes |  | Kaltura partner (account) ID. Integer, not a string, not a binding. |
| `entryId` | string |  |  | Optional media entry ID. Shows the analytics of that entry. Wins over reportType. |
| `reportType` | string |  |  | Dashboard view to show when there is no entryId. One of engagement, content-interactions, technology, geo-location, contributors, overview, publisher, enduser or live. Default: engagement. |
| `fromDate` | string |  |  | Start of the date range, as YYYY-MM-DD. Needs toDate. Default range: the last 30 days. |
| `toDate` | string |  |  | End of the date range, as YYYY-MM-DD. Needs fromDate. |
| `region` | string |  |  | Optional. The Kaltura region of this widget's account: nvp1 (US), irp2 (EU), frp2 (DE), cap2 (CA), syp2 (AP), sgp2 (SG), or a name the host app defined. Leave it out to use the app's region. A region the host app does not allow is refused. |

A2UI messages, sent after `createSurface`:

```json
[
  {
    "version": "v0.9",
    "updateComponents": {
      "surfaceId": "s",
      "components": [
        {
          "id": "root",
          "component": "KalturaAnalytics",
          "partnerId": 1,
          "entryId": "0_abc"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
]
```

The same in a web component:

```html
<kaltura-analytics></kaltura-analytics>
<script>
  document.querySelector('kaltura-analytics').config = {
    "partnerId": 1,
    "entryId": "0_abc"
  };
</script>
```

## KalturaRecorder

Kaltura Recorder: records webcam, audio or screen in the browser and uploads the recording to the account as a new entry.

Element: `<kaltura-recorder>`. Needs a KS: Yes.

| `partnerId` | integer | yes |  | Kaltura partner (account) ID. Integer, not a string, not a binding. |
| `uiconfId` | integer | yes |  | Player (uiConf) ID. The recorder uses it to load the player for the recorded entry. Integer, not a string, not a binding. |

| `allowVideo` | boolean |  |  | Allow webcam video recording. |
| `allowAudio` | boolean |  |  | Allow audio-only recording. |
| `allowScreenShare` | boolean |  |  | Allow screen recording. |

## KalturaAvatar

Kaltura Avatar: a live conversational AI agent with a video avatar, voice and captions, loaded through the Unisphere embeds API. The host's Kaltura Session picks the agent, so there is no agent or avatar ID prop. The browser asks the user for the microphone when a session starts.

Element: `<kaltura-avatar>`. Needs a KS: Yes.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `partnerId` | integer | yes |  | Kaltura partner (account) ID. Integer, not a string, not a binding. |
| `serverUrl` | string |  |  | Optional. Leave it out to use the Unisphere host of the app's region. Otherwise a Kaltura Unisphere URL (e.g. 'https://unisphere.nvp1.ovp.kaltura.com/v1'). Only Kaltura hosts are accepted (regions nvp1, irp2, frp2, cap2, syp2, sgp2). Other hosts are refused. |
| `autoConnect` | boolean |  |  | Start the session as soon as the avatar loads. Default: false, the user clicks to start. |
| `openingPhrase` | string |  |  | What the agent says first. Plain text. Default: the agent's own greeting. |
| `captions` | boolean |  |  | Show captions of what the agent says. Default: the agent's setting. |
| `theme` | "light" / "dark" / "studio" |  |  | Colour theme. Default: 'light' when the page has data-theme="light", otherwise 'dark'. |
| `region` | string |  |  | Optional. The Kaltura region of this widget's account: nvp1 (US), irp2 (EU), frp2 (DE), cap2 (CA), syp2 (AP), sgp2 (SG), or a name the host app defined. Leave it out to use the app's region. A region the host app does not allow is refused. |

A2UI messages, sent after `createSurface`:

```json
[
  {
    "version": "v0.9",
    "updateComponents": {
      "surfaceId": "s",
      "components": [
        {
          "id": "root",
          "component": "KalturaAvatar",
          "partnerId": 1,
          "serverUrl": "https://unisphere.nvp1.ovp.kaltura.com/v1"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
]
```

The same in a web component:

```html
<kaltura-avatar></kaltura-avatar>
<script>
  document.querySelector('kaltura-avatar').config = {
    "partnerId": 1,
    "serverUrl": "https://unisphere.nvp1.ovp.kaltura.com/v1"
  };
</script>
```

## KalturaChart

Kaltura Chart: 12 chart types (line, bar, area, pie, scatter, geo, wordcloud, treemap, heatmap, radar, sankey, funnel). The data is literal: to update the chart, send the component again.

Element: `<kaltura-chart>`. Needs a KS: No.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chartType` | string | yes |  | Chart type. It sets how rows are read. line, bar, area, scatter, radar: xKey is the category, yKeys are the numeric series. pie, treemap, funnel, wordcloud, geo: yKeys[0] is the value, and rows with a value of 0 or less are dropped (wordcloud draws the top 80). geo: xKey is a country name or an ISO alpha-2 code. sankey: one row per link, xKey is the source and yKeys is [target, value]. heatmap: one row per cell, xKey is the column and yKeys is [value, row]. |
| `data` | object[] | yes |  | Rows to draw, as objects. Literal only, no data binding: to update the chart, send the component again. At most 500 rows are drawn. Row shape depends on chartType. |
| `sourceData` | object[] |  |  | Full dataset for table/export view when chart shows a summary subset. |
| `title` | string |  |  | Chart title displayed above the visualization. |
| `xKey` | string |  |  | Key of the x-axis or category value in each row. Default: 'name' (pie), 'text' (wordcloud), 'country' (geo), 'source' (sankey), else the first key with a non-number value. |
| `yKeys` | string[] |  |  | Keys of the value series. Default: every key except xKey. For pie, treemap, funnel, wordcloud, geo, sankey and heatmap the order matters. See chartType. |
| `yLabels` | string[] |  |  | Human-readable labels for the yKeys series (legend labels). |
| `xLabel` | string |  |  | Label for the x-axis. |
| `yLabel` | string |  |  | Label for the y-axis. |
| `colors` | string[] |  |  | Optional color overrides for chart series (hex or CSS color strings). |
| `height` | number |  |  | Chart height in pixels. Default: 300. |
| `annotations` | object[] |  |  | Vertical annotation markers on cartesian charts (line, bar, area, scatter). |

One example row for each `chartType`:

| `chartType` | Example row | `xKey` | `yKeys` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `line` | `{"month":"Jan","plays":120,"views":80}` | `month` | `["plays","views"]` |
| `bar` | `{"course":"Intro","plays":120}` | `course` | `["plays"]` |
| `area` | `{"week":"W1","plays":120,"views":80}` | `week` | `["plays","views"]` |
| `scatter` | `{"minutes":12,"completion":80}` | `minutes` | `["completion"]` |
| `pie` | `{"name":"Mobile","value":60}` | `name` | `["value"]` |
| `geo` | `{"country":"France","plays":40}` | `country` | `["plays"]` |
| `wordcloud` | `{"text":"photosynthesis","count":12}` | `text` | `["count"]` |
| `treemap` | `{"topic":"Biology","minutes":340}` | `topic` | `["minutes"]` |
| `heatmap` | `{"day":"Mon","hour":"9am","plays":5}` | `day` | `["plays","hour"]` |
| `radar` | `{"skill":"Speed","team":3,"goal":5}` | `skill` | `["team","goal"]` |
| `sankey` | `{"from":"Home","to":"Course","visits":30}` | `from` | `["to","visits"]` |
| `funnel` | `{"stage":"Viewed","users":1000}` | `stage` | `["users"]` |

A2UI messages, sent after `createSurface`:

```json
[
  {
    "version": "v0.9",
    "updateDataModel": {
      "surfaceId": "s",
      "path": "/",
      "value": {
        "title": "Visits"
      }
    }
  },
  {
    "version": "v0.9",
    "updateComponents": {
      "surfaceId": "s",
      "components": [
        {
          "id": "root",
          "component": "KalturaChart",
          "chartType": "bar",
          "data": [
            {
              "name": "a",
              "value": 1
            },
            {
              "name": "b",
              "value": 3
            }
          ],
          "xKey": "name",
          "yKeys": [
            "value"
          ],
          "title": {
            "path": "/title"
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }
]
```

The same in a web component:

```html
<kaltura-chart></kaltura-chart>
<script>
  document.querySelector('kaltura-chart').config = {
    "chartType": "bar",
    "data": [
      {
        "name": "a",
        "value": 1
      },
      {
        "name": "b",
        "value": 3
      }
    ],
    "xKey": "name",
    "yKeys": [
      "value"
    ],
    "title": "Visits"
  };
</script>
```
